versions.content: Forwarding of MACsec related callback APIs calls towards the MKA module called by the EthTrcv driver where the EthTrcvConfig is refer- enced by an EthSwtPort Status: DRAFT If MACsec support is enabled via either the following configurations (see [SWS_EthIf_CONSTR_00013]): • MACsec support is enabled on the EthTrcvConfig which is referenced by an EthSwtPort that belong to an EthSwtConfig which is referenced by an EthIfSwitch which in turn is referenced by an EthIfController that refer- ences the affected EthIfPhysController via EthIfEthCtrlRef • MACsec support is enabled on the EthTrcvConfig which referenced by an EthSwtPort that belong to an EthSwtConfig which is referenced by an EthIfSwitchPortGroup which in turn is referenced by an EthIfController that references the affected EthIfPhysController via EthIfEthCtrlRef and one of the following MACsec callback APIs is called for an EthSwtPort that references the EthIfSwitch or the EthIfSwitchPortGroup and this EthSwtPort is referenced by a MkaPaeInstance , then EthIf shall forward the callback API call towards the MKA module by considering the MkaPaeIdx in context of the MKA module. Otherwise a callback API call shall be ignored: • a call of EthIf_SwitchMacSecUpdateSecYNotification shall be for- warded to Mka_MacSecUpdateSecYNotification • a call of EthIf_SwitchMacSecAddTxSaNotification shall be forwarded to Mka_MacSecAddTxSaNotification • a call of EthIf_SwitchMacSecAddRxSaNotification shall be forwarded to Mka_MacSecAddRxSaNotification • a call of EthIf_SwitchMacSecGetMacSecStatisticsNotification shall be forwarded to Mka_GetMacSecStatisticsNotification
